verdict: Ads are running and GBP is active, but lead tracking is broken.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, $1,687.76 ran through Google Ads and your Google Business Profile logged 110 actions — including 41 calls and 35 direction requests — so real interest is reaching your business. The problem is that your CRM and ad tracking are not connected: 16 conversions show on Google Ads, yet zero leads are recorded in the system, which means the true cost per lead cannot be calculated and pipeline data is unreliable. Separately, your Google Business Profile went completely quiet for the three days ending August 17, a confirmed drop that we are investigating now. Conversion tracking is being repaired this period, and once that connection is restored, every inbound inquiry will record correctly. The September calendar is also filling in — heating campaigns, the Homer Glen branch page, and LSA reactivation are all on schedule to launch before peak heating season.
